main_text.l: tam spectat, est ea huius communionis pars,
quae mutua huc spectantia adiumenta praestet.
Mutua aliorum obseruatio, est qua εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγαπήσεως καὶ καλῶν
ἔργων se mutuo κατανοῶσι & inquirunt. ibid.
Eius effecta sunt παρακλήσεις siue νουθετήσεις mutua.
Cognitio, vt ex scientia tum veritatis, tum neces-
sitatis mutua δυνάμενοι sint ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.
Ἀγαθωσύνη est, vt semper haec ex animi comi-
tate, & ad mutuam concordiam propensione san-
cta, per fidem mutuam praestent. Rom.1.12.
Huc etiam pertinet illud Iacob.5.16. ἐξομολογεῖσθε ἀλλήλοις τὰ παραπτώματα καὶ εὔχεσθε ὑπὲρ ἀλλήλων, ὅπως ἰαθῆτε.
am ijs mediis exitat, & auget. ibid. Rom.1.11.12.
Labes resarciens, qua se mutuo aliqua offensa

page.notes: Marginal references are set beside the text; the right-hand column of the scan partly shows the adjacent page and is omitted. Greek passages are copied as printed; some accents and breathings are uncertain.
